sources.note: Nothing on stress; states Mbula has two level tones plus downstep ('Lukas & Gerhardt (1981) transcribe Mbula using three level tones, whereas it only has two, plus downstep').

sources.citation: Van de Velde, Mark & Dmitry Idiatov. 2022. A first analysis of Mbula. Slides presented at Banto1d: First Conference on Bantoid Languages and Linguistics, Hamburg, 23-25 March 2022 (27 slides). [HAL halshs-03847067, file hosted on Idiatov's site]
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Phonology slides (pdf pp.5-12) give vowels, length, consonants, C2 lenition and tone: 'Two tone system; Up to three tones on one syllable; Major tone rules: tone spreading, tonal absorption, LH rising tones tend to be realised as M' (slide 10). No mention of stress/accent/prominence.
